decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully captures the approved 50A power supply, higher-power PWM controllers, and reserve-capacity requirement.

The approved higher-power controllers and 50A adapter may require physical accommodation in the system layout, but the evidence does not establish whether the CAD must represent these components or requires revision.
Approval of the electrical BOM selections does not change the required mixing, frothing, whisk, or high-speed behavior.
The basic wiring plan must reflect the client-approved power supply and motor-controller configuration selected for the prototype.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The BOM is approved. Please place the orders, and I’ll reimburse you.

decisions.reason: The approved electrical component selections do not alter the existing splash target, high-speed constraint, or permitted mitigation methods.
BOM approval does not change bowl removal, clearance, or rapid-swap behavior.
Selecting a 50A AC/DC adapter does not replace or modify the approved standard 120V wall-outlet power source.
The approved controller and adapter selections do not change bowl capacity, depth, enclosure-size constraints, or geometry priorities.
Electrical BOM approval does not alter the required plumbing seals or leak-free bowl-bottom behavior.
The compatibility confirmation and BOM approval do not change the specified anti-rattle, anti-shift, base, or foot requirements.
The approved electrical components do not change whisk removability, tool-free preference, clearance, or removal purposes.
Higher-power PWM controllers support the existing variable-speed implementation but do not change the approved 0-to-3000-RPM range or intended speed modes.
